controlled.hooks: pre-commit and prek produced the same changed files, content SHA-256, and diff SHA-256 for the frozen parity fixture.

external_validity.boundary: Unknown real-repository defect ground truth means nonzero exits and output volume are operational observations only, not recall or quality rankings.

classification: Release-channel maturity and controlled semantic detection are separate evidence dimensions.
The frozen fixture falsifies any rule that treats stable status alone as sufficient evidence for default static-type authority.
The study does not establish universal checker accuracy, because the controlled corpus is deliberately small and real repositories lack complete defect ground truth.
The externally valid decision is procedural: promote a blocking authority only after repository-relevant ground-truth checks, while using release status separately for operational maturity risk.
